label: Bible Study
prompt: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is _____, and in him is no darkness at all.
verse: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
note: John's message in one line — God is light, with no shadows at all.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Rejoicing in _____; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verse: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
note: Three quick habits from Paul: rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Saul armed David with his _____, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
verse: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
note: Saul lent David his own armour and helmet — David tried walking in it and politely gave it all back.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD _____ up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verse: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
note: Cyrus's decree freed the exiles to go home and rebuild — fulfilling what God had spoken through Jeremiah.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The officers answered, Never man _____ like this man.
verse: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
note: Temple officers sent to arrest Jesus came back empty-handed with this excuse: 'Never man spake like this man.'
